description: Überschwemmungsgebiete im Gebiet der Stadt Hameln (INSPIRE) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inspire.hameln.de. The INSPIRE data set areas with natural risks contains the statutory floodplains of the rivers Hamel, Hastebach, Humme, Mainbach, Remte and Weser in the area of the city of Hameln. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Floodplains in the area of the city of Hameln (INSPIRE)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert, Stadt Hameln. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2025-11-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
